verdict.rationale: The docs describe agents (Literature, Precedent, Kosmos) that search across 175M+ external papers/trials, and Kosmos can take 'one or more datasets' as input for analysis, but there is no evidence of a feature letting a researcher upload their own PDFs or a custom corpus for the agent to search/reason over. missing for 10: PDF/corpus upload mechanism, ingestion pipeline, any mention of user-supplied document collections.
